answer:
The OpenAI-compatible endpoint that lets apps stream speech audio generated by Ollama on macOS is `/v1/audio/speech`. This is supported as described in the documentation:

- "Ollama can now generate [speech](https://docs.ollama.com/capabilities/speech) on macOS. `ollama run` plays text or a chat model's reply aloud as the audio is generated, and apps can stream audio through the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/audio/speech` endpoint." [ollama/v0.40.11.md](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/tag/v0.40.11)

- Additionally, the details of using this endpoint are provided: "Use the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/audio/speech` endpoint." [ollama/docs/capabilities/speech.md](#) (lines 56-112)

These lines confirm that the `/v1/audio/speech` endpoint is the correct one for streaming speech audio generated by Ollama.
